def solve(grid):
    H=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v==3 for v in row)][0]
    V=[c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[r][c]==3 for r in range(len(grid)))][0]
    return [[3 if grid[r][c]==3 else (4 if max(abs(r-H),abs(c-V))%2==0 else 0) for c in range(len(grid[0]))] for r in range(len(grid))]
